dict.string: Unipi uses the camera to scan the pairing QR code from your computer and to take photos you attach to chats and tasks.
Unipi lets you pick photos and videos to attach to chats and tasks.
Unipi saves images and files you download from your computer to your photo library.
Unipi uses the microphone when you record a video to attach to a chat or task.
Unipi connects directly to your computers on the local network for faster, private connections.
